provenance.source: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; HST model pole with arbitrary fixed phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Tuttle Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. Two touching lobes inferred from Hubble brightness changes and sized using Spitzer infrared measurements. The smooth gray surface represents the model. Its rotation phase is illustrative.
